summary.text: Jeff Farnan is a Republican state representative who has represented Missouri House District 1 since January 2023 and is the only candidate on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot for the seat.
He is an optician and cattle farmer and a former school board president.

paragraphs.text: Farnan was born in Nodaway County, Missouri, and graduated from South Nodaway High School. His career experience includes working as an optician and cattle farmer.
He served as a member and president of the Jefferson C-123 School Board.
Farnan assumed office in the Missouri House of Representatives on January 4, 2023, succeeding Allen Andrews.
His 2025-2026 committee assignments are Conservation and Natural Resources, which he chairs, and Professional Registration and Licensing.
